A luxury sedan with the heart of a sports car.2016 Porsche Panamera 4S | 3.0L Twin-Turbo V6  PDK  All-Wheel DriveSome luxury sedans are built to be comfortable.Others are built to be fast.Porsche decided there was absolutely no reason you couldn't have both.Meet the 2016 Porsche Panamera 4S, finished in an exceptionally elegant deep blue exterior over a beautiful beige leather interior.And what a combination it is.The deep blue paint gives this Panamera a sophisticated, understated presence, while the light beige interior creates a warm, inviting contrast that feels unmistakably upscale.It's the kind of color combination that makes an already special vehicle feel even more distinctive.But underneath that elegant exterior is something even more interesting.A genuine Porsche.A twin-turbocharged V6.Porsche's lightning-quick PDK transmission.Intelligent all-wheel drive.And the engineering philosophy that has made the Porsche name legendary among driving enthusiasts.This isn't simply a luxury sedan wearing a Porsche badge.It's a Porsche that happens to have four doors.?? What Makes This Porsche Panamera 4S ExtraordinaryThere's a wonderful contradiction at the heart of the Porsche Panamera.On one hand, it's a beautifully appointed luxury sedan designed to carry four A distinctive expression of British performance and craftsmanship, this 2022 Aston Martin DBX pairs Magnetic Silver metallic paint with an elegantly contrasting cabin in Onyx Black and Oxford Tan Haircell leather. Its Create Duotone interior and carefully coordinated exterior details give this example a compelling blend of sporting presence and understated sophistication.  A 542 hp 4.0L twin turbo V8 is paired with a 9 speed automatic transmission and all wheel drive with an active transfer case. A rear electronic limited slip differential, triple chamber air suspension with adaptive damping, and Electronic Active Roll Control bring precision and composure to the driving experience. With 6 selectable drive modes, the DBX offers a broad range of character within its bespoke aluminum body structure.  The upper and lower Black Packs sharpen the contrast against the Magnetic Silver finish, complemented by a gloss black grille and black Aston Martin wings and wordmark. Optional 22 inch Sport Satin Black wheels reinforce the purposeful stance, while smoked rear lamps and full LED automatic headlights complete the exterior presentation.  Inside, the warmth of Oxford Tan and the depth of Onyx Black create an inviting setting, enriched by contrast stitching, the Dark Chrome Jewellery Pack and a Contemporary Alcantara headlining. The panoramic glass roof adds a sense of openness, with an Alcantara roof blind providing a tailored finishing touch. Heated and ventilated front and rear seats, 16 way seat adjustment and a heated sports steering wheel make comfort an integral part of the specification. An Aston Martin Designer Key Set adds another distinctive factory detail.  A 10 inch navigation display with Apple CarPlay works alongside a 12 inch digital instrument cluster, Bluetooth connectivity and inductive mobile phone charging. A 360 degree camera with front and rear parking sensors assists with close surroundings, while adaptive cruise control, blind spot warning, lane departure warning, lane keep assist and autonomous emergency braking provide additional driving support.  Originally specified with an MSRP of $221,886, this DBX brings together a richly detailed interior, an assertive exterior treatment and the performance expected of Aston Martin. Its combination of carefully chosen materials, meaningful options and everyday versatility makes it a compelling expression of the marque's grand touring spirit.
